SELECT @@IDENTITY AS ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_MAP SET CATEGORY=#category# WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
UPDATE T_MAP SET TARGET_ID=#targetID#, CATEGORY=#category# WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
UPDATE T_MAP SET TARGET_ID=#targetID#, CATEGORY=#category# WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
UPDATE T_MAP SET MAP_ID=#mapID#, POSX=#posX#, POSY=#posY#, AREA=#area#, TYPE=#type#, STATE=#state#, TARGET_ID=#targetID#, CATEGORY=#category# WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM T_MAP WHERE CATEGORY=#category# AND AREA=#area#
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM T_MAP TM, T_MAP_MONSTER TMM WHERE TM.TARGET_ID=TMM.MAP_MONSTER_ID AND TM.CATEGORY=#category# AND TM.AREA=#area# AND TMM.LEVEL=#mapMonsterLevel#

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE MAP_ID NOT IN (SELECT M.MAP_ID FROM T_MAP M, T_DEPOY_QUEUE DQ WHERE M.MAP_ID=DQ.MAP_ID) AND STATE=1 AND CATEGORY=4

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE TARGET_ID=#targetID# AND CATEGORY=#category#
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE MAP_ID=#mapID#
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM T_MAP WHERE (CATEGORY=#blankFieldCategory# OR CATEGORY=#monsterCategory#) AND AREA=#area#
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MAP WHERE TYPE>=10 AND TYPE<20 AND CATEGORY=#category#
SELECT MAP_ID FROM T_MAP WHERE TYPE>=10 AND TYPE<20 AND CATEGORY=3
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE area=#area# AND CATEGORY=#category# ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE POSX>=#startX# AND POSX<=#endX# AND POSY>=#startY# AND POSY<=#endY# AND CATEGORY=#category# ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE POSX>=#startX# AND POSX<=#endX# AND POSY>=#startY# AND POSY<=#endY#
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE POSX=#posX# AND POSY=#posY#
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID FROM T_MAP WHERE CATEGORY=#category# AND AREA=#area# ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 0, #num#
SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE TYPE>=10 AND TYPE<20 AND CATEGORY=3

SELECT MAP_ID AS mapID, POSX AS posX, POSY AS posY, AREA AS area, TYPE AS type, STATE AS state, TARGET_ID AS targetID, CATEGORY AS category FROM T_MAP WHERE (POSX*POSX+POSY*POSY)>#radius#*#radius# AND (POSX*POSX+POSY*POSY)<(#radius#+#range#)*(#radius#+#range#)
